verdict.rationale: Paddle supports event-driven automation via webhooks that push real-time notifications on billing events, and has some built-in conditional automation like dunning/Tactical Retries and payment recovery configuration, but there's no general-purpose rule-defining engine (e.g., 'if event X then do Y') for arbitrary triggers/actions — webhooks just notify your server, and you must write your own logic to act on them. missing for 10: a native no-code/low-code rule builder or trigger-action automation UI, support for defining custom conditional logic beyond dunning/retry settings, and evidence of AI-agent-defined automation rules (vs. AI agents manually calling APIs via MCP).
